+    def cancel(self) -> None:
+        """Cancel an unshipped order and release its reserved stock."""
+        if self.state == CANCELLED:

item.text:
Implemented `Order.cancel()` for NEW and PAID orders, including stock release, PAID refunds, idempotent repeated cancellation, and rejection of SHIPPED or DELIVERED orders. Implemented validated `Inventory.release()` and added tests for cancellation and release behavior.

`python -m pytest -q` passes: **32 passed**. Changes are limited to [orders.py](/Users/jimmynguyen/.cache/codex-practices-lab/work/20261118-054311-plan-t04-f566/repo/src/shoplib/orders.py), [inventory.py](/Users/jimmynguyen/.cache/codex-practices-lab/work/20261118-054311-plan-t04-f566/repo/src/shoplib/inventory.py), and the two related test files.
